title: Hoopoe
blurb: Hoopoes are colourful birds found across Africa, Asia, and Europe, notable for their distinctive "crown" of feathers which can be raised or lowered at will.
facts: In fact, some taxonomists still consider the species to be conspecific.
On the other hand, some authorities recognize three living species, with the African hoopoe treated as separate from the Eurasian hoopoe.
The Eurasian hoopoe is common in its range and has a large population, so it is evaluated as Least Concern on the IUCN Red List of Threatened Species.
